tagline: Capture tasks from Slack into Todoist without breaking your flow
metaTitle: Todoist Slack Integration: Save Tasks with an Emoji Reaction
metaDescription: React to a Slack message to save it as a Todoist task and get a morning task briefing. GAIA tracks team commitments. See the setup steps.
intro: You get assigned things in Slack all day long. 'Can you handle X?' and 'Don't forget Y' messages pile up and then scroll away. Without a system to capture these, important tasks fall through the cracks. GAIA captures action items from Slack and adds them to Todoist immediately, so your personal task list reflects everything you've committed to.

useCases.title: Save action items with a reaction
useCases.description: React to any Slack message with a designated emoji and GAIA creates a corresponding task. The message content becomes the task description, timestamped and linked back to the thread.

useCases.title: Morning Todoist briefing in Slack
useCases.description: GAIA sends you a DM every morning summarizing your tasks due today and tomorrow so you can plan your day without opening another app.

useCases.title: Task reminders in Slack
useCases.description: Instead of relying on Todoist's push notifications, GAIA sends overdue task reminders as DMs when you're active in chat so reminders reach you where you're already working.

useCases.title: Team commitment tracking
useCases.description: When you commit to something in a thread, GAIA detects the commitment ('I'll have that ready by Thursday') and automatically adds a task with the appropriate due date.

useCases.title: Channel-specific task capture
useCases.description: Configure GAIA to monitor specific channels and automatically add action items mentioned there to the corresponding project, keeping channel work and personal tasks in sync.

howItWorks.step: Connect Slack and Todoist to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Add GAIA to your Slack workspace and authorize your Todoist account. This takes under two minutes.
Pick how you want to save tasks: emoji reactions, GAIA mentions, or automatic detection of assignment language. Configure the default project for tasks created from chat.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your task list current
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors for tasks and commitments and adds them to your list. You can also ask GAIA at any time to 'add this to my tasks' directly in chat.

faqs.question: Which emoji should I use to trigger task creation?
faqs.answer: You can configure any emoji as your task trigger in GAIA settings. Common choices are the white check mark, clipboard, or bookmark emoji. GAIA will confirm the task was created with a reaction back on the message.

faqs.question: Can GAIA detect when tasks are completed in Todoist and react in Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you complete a task that was created from a message, GAIA can post a completion confirmation to the original thread so collaborators know the work is done.

faqs.question: Does this integration work for personal accounts or only teams?
faqs.answer: It works for both personal and team accounts. Individual users can use it to capture personal tasks from chat, while teams can use it to manage shared project tasks.
